court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: Substantial evidence for fitness determination
issues.why: Court must decide whether the Board's finding that narcolepsy did not significantly interfere with duties is supported by substantial evidence.

issues.label: Standard of review application
issues.why: Court must apply arbitrary, capricious, contrary to law, or unsupported by substantial evidence standard to the Board decision.

issues.label: Failure to consider relevant factors
issues.why: A Board decision ignoring relevant factors like VA disability rating may be arbitrary and capricious.

issues.label: Weight of VA narcolepsy diagnosis and rating
issues.why: Court must assess how the Board treated the VA's 40% service-connected rating effective at discharge.

issues.label: Effect of PEB reliance on wrong records
issues.why: The PEB initially used another servicemember's records, raising questions about the integrity of its conclusion.

issues.label: Applicability of liberal consideration
issues.why: Court must determine whether liberal consideration applies despite Mr. Qoye's honorable discharge.

issues.label: Timeliness of recoupment claim
issues.why: Court must decide whether the reenlistment bonus recoupment claim is barred by the statute of limitations.

issues.label: Timeliness of record-correction claim
issues.why: Court must decide whether the service-record correction claim is time-barred under the six-year limitations period.

issues.label: Statute of limitations accrual date
issues.why: When each claim accrued affects whether the Tucker Act limitations period bars them.

issues.label: Continuing claim or accrual suspension doctrines
issues.why: Whether disability retirement pay constitutes a continuing claim or accrual was suspended affects timeliness.

issues.label: Board proceedings toll or reset limitations
issues.why: Whether Board petitions and remands affect running of the limitations period must be resolved.

issues.label: Proper basis for NEC removal
issues.why: Court must decide whether NEC was removed for misconduct or medical unfitness, as disputed in the record.

issues.label: Whether NEC removal actually occurred
issues.why: There is factual dispute over whether the Navy actually removed his NEC in April 2011.

issues.label: NJP misconduct relationship to narcolepsy
issues.why: Court must assess Board's finding that falsifying logs was not mitigated by a sleep disorder.

issues.label: Failure to refer to MEB/PEB during service
issues.why: The Navy's failure to properly diagnose and refer Mr. Qoye bears on the fitness analysis.

issues.label: Adequacy of narcolepsy testing during service
issues.why: The Navy tested only for apnea, not narcolepsy, potentially affecting the fitness determination.

issues.label: Reliability of post hoc PEB determination
issues.why: Whether a retrospective fitness determination on old records can substitute for a timely evaluation.

issues.label: Relevance of post-service mechanic application
issues.why: Court relied on 2015 job application as evidence of fitness; its probative value must be weighed.

issues.label: Reliance on performance evaluations
issues.why: Evaluations showed no fatigue interference despite eyewitness accounts; their weight must be assessed.

issues.label: Scope and compliance with remand order
issues.why: Court directed Board to address all issues; whether Board complied on remand must be verified.

issues.label: Tucker Act money-mandating jurisdiction
issues.why: Disability retirement pay statute must be money-mandating for the court to have jurisdiction over monetary claims.

issues.label: Entitlement to placement on PDRL
issues.why: Court must determine whether the record supports permanent disability retired list placement.

issues.label: Entitlement to retirement back pay
issues.why: Monetary relief depends on establishing eligibility for disability retirement.

issues.label: Reenlistment bonus recoupment validity
issues.why: Court must decide whether recoupment was proper given the disputed reason for failing to complete service.

issues.label: Motion to dismiss vs judgment on record standards
issues.why: Court applied different procedural standards; each claim must be analyzed under the correct one.

issues.label: Weight of fellow servicemember testimony
issues.why: Eyewitness accounts of falling asleep on watch conflict with evaluations and must be reconciled.
